description: Source code for the TestInfo implementation and related classes in Playwright, handling test steps, attachments, timeouts, and reporting.

classes.name: TestInfoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TestInfo, managing test execution, steps, attachments, timeouts, and reporting.

classes.name: TestStepInfoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TestStepInfo, representing individual test steps with attach and skip capabilities.

classes.name: TestSkipError
classes.description: Error class used to signal a skipped test.

classes.name: StepSkipError
classes.description: Error class used to signal a skipped step.

methods.name: _modifier
methods.description: Apply a test modifier like skip, fixme, fail, or slow, with optional description and location.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Create and add a new test step, handling hierarchy, stack trace, and reporting.

methods.name: _failWithError
methods.description: Mark the test as failed with a given error, capturing stack trace and updating status.

methods.name: _runAsStep
methods.description: Run a function as a test step, capturing errors and completing the step accordingly.

methods.name: _runWithTimeout
methods.description: Execute a callback with timeout management, handling errors and test interruption.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attach a file or data to the test report.

methods.name: _attach
methods.description: Internal method to add an attachment and associate it with a test step.

methods.name: outputPath
methods.description: Generate a file path within the test's output directory.

methods.name: _getOutputPath
methods.description: Resolve a path within the output directory, ensuring it stays inside the allowed directory.

methods.name: _fsSanitizedTestName
methods.description: Generate a sanitized filename based on the test's title.

methods.name: _resolveSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Compute file paths for snapshots, screenshots, or aria snapshots based on templates.

methods.name: _applyPathTemplate
methods.description: Apply a path template to generate a snapshot file path.

methods.name: snapshotPath
methods.description: Get the path for a snapshot, screenshot, or aria snapshot, with options for kind and naming.

methods.name: artifactsDir
methods.description: Get the directory for test artifacts.
